description:
Brand Introduction

At airwheel.com.au, we specialize in innovative, high-quality, and stylish electric rideable luggage designed to revolutionize travel convenience. As the leading provider in Australia, we focus on integrating advanced technology with everyday functionality, offering products that cater to travelers, professionals, and families seeking seamless mobility solutions. Our mission is to redefine the travel experience by merging practicality, efficiency, and modern design.

Product Description

Our flagship products include a range of electric rideable luggage models designed for various needs:

  • Airwheel SE3S: Compact yet powerful, perfect for urban commuters and light travelers. Features adjustable speed modes and app connectivity.

  • Airwheel SE3T: A versatile rideable suitcase with enhanced storage capacity, suitable for long trips and business travelers.

  • Airwheel SE3miniT: A lightweight and highly portable option for on-the-go convenience.

  • Airwheel SE3SL: The newest and lightest model at just 6.8 kg. Equipped with an auto-locking system and RGB lights, designed for both adults and kids who want style and ease in their journey.

  • Airwheel SQ3: Specially designed for children aged 3-6 years, combining safety and fun in a vibrant, interactive design-ideal for short trips and playtime.

  • Airwheel SQ3S: An upgraded version of the SQ3, tailored for children aged 6-10 years. It features a larger battery and built-in Bluetooth speaker, making travel and outdoor activities more enjoyable.

Each model incorporates intelligent controls, durable materials, and an eco-friendly electric motor for effortless travel.

Unique Selling Point (USP)

  1. Innovative Mobility: Our electric rideable luggage combines travel essentials with personal mobility, ensuring convenience and speed for travelers.
  2. Smart App Integration: Control speed, monitor battery life, and adjust settings via a dedicated mobile app.
  3. Safety for All Ages: Equipped with adjustable speed modes, including a safe "low gear" for children.
  4. Durability and Design: Built with high-quality materials, our luggage is designed to withstand the rigors of travel while maintaining a sleek aesthetic.
  5. Eco-Friendly Travel: Powered by rechargeable batteries, our products are a sustainable alternative for short-distance commutes.

Payment Terms

  • Accepted Payment Methods: Visa, MasterCard, ShopPay and bank transfers.
  • Flexible Payment Options: Installment plans available through Afterpay for added convenience.
  • Secure Transactions: All payments are processed through encrypted and secure payment gateways to ensure customer protection.

Other Information

  • Warranty and After-Sales Service: All products come with a 12-month warranty and dedicated customer support for repairs or replacements.
  • Shipping: Fast and reliable delivery across Australia with free shipping on orders over AUD 150.
  • Customer Insights Program: Participate in our post-purchase survey to share your experience and help us improve!
